forms.title: eVisa Madagascar — tourist eVisa (Electronic Travel Authorisation)
forms.stoppedAt: 'Apply' redirects to the log-in page (email and password); the application is filled in only after registering an account. Only the public pre-login pages were read.

steps.name: Create your account
notices: Before you start: Valid passport; Payment card; Access to your email and phone
Fill in your information (identity and travel information)
The traveler can apply for a visa between one week and 6 months before departure.
All nationalities are eligible for eVisa
Currently only the tourist visa is supported by the eVisa system
The tourist eVisa is a single entry visa with a maximum duration of 60 days.

steps.name: Proceed to payment
notices: Use your credit card to pay
The prices of the online visa are the same as those paid on arrival

steps.name: Download your electronic travel authorisation
notices: This authorisation allows you to fly and enter Madagascar
An Electronic Travel Authorization is issued no later than 72 hours after validation of your online registration
The document is to be printed or kept in the smartphone for police control upon arrival
